_comment: Venue cost schedules, 2026-08-31. Cost is expressed in PROBABILITY POINTS (fraction, not %) so it drops straight into the vig_paid_pp slot: net_edge = clv_prob_delta - cost. See src/venue-cost.js.
_why: vig_paid_pp = placedImplied - placed_novig_prob, i.e. the probability overcharge. On an exchange there is no book hold; the overcharge is the per-contract fee, which is already denominated in dollars per $1 of payout = probability points. Same units, no conversion.

sportsbook.label: Sportsbook (measured, not modelled)
sportsbook.note: Use the ticket's own vig_paid_pp. Books differ per market and per line; a formula would be a worse estimate than the measurement we already take.

kalshi.label: Kalshi
kalshi.note: fee per contract = coefficient * P * (1-P). Peaks at P=0.50. Sources disagree on whether the taker multiplier is 0.06 or 0.07 for sports; 0.07 is the conservative (higher-cost) reading. Maker fees reportedly round to zero on small orders - NOT modelled as zero here, because a rounding artifact is not a fee schedule.

novig.label: Novig
novig.note: fee per contract = min(0.03 * P * (1-P), 0.0075). Makers pay nothing and may earn a credit of up to half the taker fee; the credit is NOT modelled - unmodelled upside is safe, unmodelled cost is not.

dk_predictions.label: DraftKings Predictions
dk_predictions.note: Fee schedule not confirmed. Deliberately left unmodelled so it cannot silently be treated as free.
